title: BI stops 4 Filipinos bound for Myanmar over suspected illegal recruitment
summary: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) intercepted four Filipino passengers at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) over suspicions that they had been recruited for overseas employment in Myanmar…

blocks.text: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) intercepted four Filipino passengers at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) over suspicions that they had been recruited for overseas employment in Myanmar under questionable travel arrangements.
